basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Randonauting creates a random point on the map near you for you to visit.

permissions.name: Location
permissions.why: To generate a random point near you and show it on the map.

services.name: AI Randonauting chat
services.what: Messages you send to the AI chat are processed to create your adventure ideas.

services.name: Maps
services.what: To show the generated point on a map.

purchases: Premium is sold through the App Store as a subscription. Apple handles payment.
